requirements.statement: A submission is expired when evaluated_at >= submission_deadline.

findings.title: Strict-greater-than operator excludes the deadline-equal boundary required by REQ-TRIAGE-001

source_anchors.excerpt: A submission is expired when evaluated_at >= submission_deadline.

test_anchors.excerpt: test_before_deadline_is_open; test_after_deadline_is_expired — no test for evaluated_at == submission_deadline

findings.rationale: REQ-TRIAGE-001 (SRC-TRIAGE-001-PRD, ACTIVE, authority: product_contract) states expiry when evaluated_at >= submission_deadline, which is an inclusive-boundary condition. The implementation at line 7 uses the strict operator '>' and therefore does not mark a submission as expired when evaluated_at equals submission_deadline exactly. This is a direct, documented mismatch at the inclusion/exclusion boundary. Domain rules classify this as BOUNDARY_CONDITION_DRIFT (most-specific type per policy). The severity rubric maps a confirmed deadline/eligibility boundary change to HIGH. The test suite exercises only the strictly-before and strictly-after cases; the equality boundary (evaluated_at == submission_deadline) has no acceptance test, corroborating the drift.
findings.suggested_human_check: Verify whether the intended operator is '>=' (inclusive, per REQ-TRIAGE-001) or '>' (exclusive). If '>=', fix implementation and add a test for the equality boundary.

findings.title: No test exercises the equality boundary evaluated_at == submission_deadline

source_anchors.excerpt: A submission is expired when evaluated_at >= submission_deadline.

findings.rationale: REQ-TRIAGE-001 explicitly establishes an inclusion boundary at evaluated_at == submission_deadline ('>='). The test file contains only two cases: strictly before the deadline and strictly after the deadline. The equality boundary, which is the distinguishing point between '>=' and '>', is not exercised by any test. Per domain rule DR-007, an explicit acceptance boundary without a matching test warrants REVIEW_REQUIRED and MISSING_ACCEPTANCE_TEST classification. Severity MEDIUM per the rubric ('explicit acceptance scenario missing from tests').
findings.suggested_human_check: Add a test case where evaluated_at equals submission_deadline and assert the result is True (expired).
